description: Search a knowledge base for chunks containing a word or phrase (case-insensitive substring match). Free and instant — no embeddings. The exact-term complement to Semantic Search; wire a Knowledge Base node into its knowledge_base input the same way.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Word or phrase to match within chunk content

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base to search, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of results to return

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.description: Optional: restrict results to a specific document uuid.
